senses.gloss:
पर + -इतर a.
—1 other than inimical, i. e. friendly, kind.
—2 oneʼs own; विधाय रक्षान् परितः परेतरान् Ki. 1. 14.

पर + -ईशः
—1 an epithet of Brahman.
—2 of Viṣṇu.
पर + -इष्टिः N. of Brahman.
पर + -इष्टुका a cow which has often calved.
परेष्टः f., परेष्टुका A cow that has often calved.

परे (परा-इ) €2 P.
—1 To go or run away, flee, retreat; यः परैति स जीवति Pt. 5. 88
 ‘he who runs away saves his life’; cf. ‘to run for oneʼs life’.
—2 To reach, attain to; परैति कार्श्यं यशसा समं वपुः Ki. 1. 39.
—3 To depart from this world, die.

पारे ind. On the other side of; पारेश्मशानं सरित् Māl. 5. 19;
 पारेसमुद्रं लङ्कायां वसन्तं रावणं पतिम् Bk. 5. 4; see पार above.
परेत p. p. Deceased, departed, dead.

परेत + .{@-तः@} A spirit, a ghost.
.━{@Comp.@}: परेतकल्प^1, परेतकालः, परेतभर्तृ, परेतराजः^2, परेतभूमिः

[2] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/8ab1240.

परेत + -कल्प^1 a. almost dead.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.

परेत + -कालः The time of death; परेतकाले पुरुषो यत् कर्म प्रतिपद्यते
 Rām. 3. 51. 31.

परेत + -भर्तृ, -राजः^1 m. the god of death, Yama; परेतभर्तुर्महिषः Śi. 1. 57.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/8ab1240.

परेत + -भर्तृ, -राजः^1 m. the god of death, Yama; परेतभर्तुर्महिषः Śi. 1. 57.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/8ab1240.

परेत + -भूमिः f., {@-वासः@}
 a cemetery; विकीर्णकेशासु परेतभूमिषु Ku. 5. 68.
परेतिः f. Ved. Departure.
परेद्यवि, परेद्युस् ind. The other day.
परेद्यवि, परेद्युस् ind. The other day.

परेयिवस् a. Dead, departed; कथा इमास्ते कथिता महीयसां विधाय
 लोकेषु यशः परेयुषाम् Bhāg. 12. 3. 14.
परेष्टः f., परेष्टुका A cow that has often calved.
पारेरकः A sword (?).
पारेवतः A kind of date.
